title: Purse and basket fixture
premise: Exercise a fictional purchase, a bounded purse and a receipt ending.

opening.text: This small fixture tests declared shopping resources without claiming a historical transaction. The purse, basket, prices, decision and receipt are invented solely to exercise the same bounded mechanics used by authored outings.

stops.text: Stand outside the store and make one fictional choice. Buying the parcel spends seventy-five cents, takes ten story minutes and puts a receipt in the basket; browsing leaves every declared resource unchanged.

choices.label: Buy the parcel
choices.consequence: Spend seventy-five fictional cents and keep the receipt.

choices.label: Browse and move on
choices.consequence: Keep the purse closed and leave the basket empty.

endings.text: The fictional receipt records the bounded purchase path.
The purse stayed closed and the basket stayed empty.

keepsake.title: A Careful Basket
keepsake.text: A test keepsake for the fictional shopping path.

evidence.text: The purse, basket, price, elapsed story time, choices, receipt and endings are invented test content rather than a claim about a historical purchase.
